list.intro: Drag an experience by its handle, or use the arrows, to change the order shown on your profile.
list.orderOutdated: The list had changed elsewhere. It was reloaded, move it again.
list.title: {{position}}, {{name}}

empty.title: No experience
empty.body: Add the servers or services you worked for. A verified experience can be featured in a post.

aside.auto: Automatic: for a server where you currently work, Lineup reads your permissions on that server through Discord.
aside.manual: Manual review: for a past role or a service, the Moddy team looks at your request.
aside.reset: Changing the position, dates or server of a verified experience removes the verification.

dnd.instructions: Press Space or Enter to pick up the experience, up and down arrows to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, Escape to cancel.

dialog.limit: You have {{count}} / {{max}} experiences. Delete one to add another.

fields.inviteHelp: The server name is taken from the invite.
fields.newInviteHelp: Leave empty to keep the server. A different server removes the verification.
fields.inviteHow: How to create a permanent invite
fields.name: Service name
fields.nameHelp: For example a platform, a nonprofit, a company.

before.verified: Changing the position, dates or server will remove the verification.
before.pending: Changing the position, dates or server will cancel the review request in progress.
before.rejected: Changing the position, dates or server will clear the refusal. You can ask for a verification again.

resets.verified: This change will remove the verification. You can ask for it again afterwards.
resets.pending: This change will cancel the review request in progress.
resets.rejected: This change will clear the refusal. You can ask for a verification again.

warning.keeps: Adding an end date to a verified, current experience keeps the verification.

problems.startFuture: The start date cannot be in the future.
problems.endRequired: Enter the end date, or tick "Current role".
problems.endFuture: The end date cannot be in the future.
problems.endBeforeStart: The end cannot be before the start.

delete.title: Delete {{title}}?
delete.body: This experience and its verification will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.featured: If one of your posts features it, the post loses that highlight.

status.pending: Review request sent, waiting for the Moddy team.
status.rejectedHelp: Fix the experience if needed, then ask for a verification again.

unverified.service: Not verified. A service is verified by a manual review.
unverified.current: Not verified. Only a verified experience can be featured in a post.
unverified.ended: Not verified. A past role is verified by a manual review.

evidence.private: Visible to you and the Moddy team only.

reauth.title: Allow Lineup to read your servers.
reauth.body: The automatic check reads your permissions on the server. You will go through Discord again, then come back here.

review.intro: The Moddy team looks at the request. You can add a detail.
review.noteHelp: For example: how to confirm your role.
